page.layout: One printed page, numbered 747 at top right. Running title "TABVLA VII." at top. Full-width tree diagrams (tables VII to X) with braces and brackets, read top to bottom. Small partly cut-off labels at the left edge are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Increata infinita, & ad modum intelligendi nostrum non proportionata: vt, Deus opt. max.
Determinata ad aliud quod informet: vt, anima hominis.
Secunda: vt est omnis materia mixta.
Actiua, seu Forma, quae etiam vel
Secunda, vt sunt omnes formae subordinatae, praeter formam hominis, quae spiritus est.
main_text.p: Ex creata & increata compofita admirabilis vnionis myfterio, vt CHRISTVS IESVS, Dei & virginis Filius.
main_text.head: TABVLA VIII.
main_text.l: Ex vtroque generatur Meteora, quae ratione fubiecti ad substantias referuntur, & sunt vel
Ignotea, vt stella cadens, cometa, coruscatio.
Aquea. Nubes, Iris, Pluuia, Nix, grando.
main_text.head: TABVLA IX.
main_text.l: Aliena a mixtione, vt coelum, in quo spectantur parties
Extensae & rariores, quae orbes dicuntur, & iterum vel
Densiores & velut conglobatae, siue stellae: quae sunt vel
Saturnus, Iupiter, Mars, Sol, Venus, Mercurius, Luna.
Ordinata ad mixtionem, & ideo separatim per se & completè non existens, vnde & Elementum dicitur: quod est
main_text.head: TABVLA X.
main_text.l: Incompletum, vt sulphur, argentum viuum, vitriolum,
Communis: Scrupuli, saxa, rupes, silex, cos.
Non ita preciosi: Marmor, porphyrites, Alabastrites.
Creta, Lemnia, Samia, Silesiaca, & quaedam sigillata.
Liquabile: vt Alumen, bitumen, naphtha, Thus, Myrrha, Succinum, &c. lacrymae, &c.

page.notes: Tree diagrams were read as outlines; the level numbers are approximate depths read from the braces. Several Greek words in Tab. VII and VIII are illegible at this scan resolution and are marked accordingly. Printed marks on the left edge are cut off and were not transcribed.
